settings.description: Our formula is designed to provide comprehensive support for your pet's health with these key benefits.
settings.benefit_1_text: Increases energy levels while helping to relieve seasonal and food allergies for a happier, more active pet.
settings.benefit_2_text: Probiotics support healthy digestion and maintain optimal gut flora balance for better nutrient absorption.
settings.benefit_3_text: Promotes a shinier coat and reduces itching with essential fatty acids and targeted nutrients for skin health.
settings.benefit_4_text: Reduces inflammation and supports joint mobility with glucosamine and chondroitin for better quality of life.
settings.benefit_5_text: Better gut health leads to stronger immune function, helping your pet stay healthy and resilient year-round.
settings.benefit_6_text: CoQ10 provides cardiovascular support for optimal heart function and improved circulation as pets age.
